body.$description: At night only a trace of white: in the dark, a film turns the glass dull gray. The light on its edge does the work.

highlight.$description: In the dark, light reads stronger: the band inside the edge facing the light is bright.

shadow-color.$description: On the dark marble a shadow needs more strength to show.

rim-lit.$description: The edge facing the light, at full brightness against the dark marble.
